newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: European gold starts weaker before options expiry.
newsitem.headline: European gold starts weaker before options expiry.

text.p: Gold started weaker in Europe on Wednesday and traders said it was likely to move down again after OTC options expire later in the day.
Gold opened at $351.40/351.90 an ounce, down $1.40 from $352.80/353.30 at the London close on Tuesday.
"Gold has almost always been weaker after the OTC expiry lately," one Zurich trader said.
Gold could test $350 and if support breaks there the metal could go down towards January lows of around $346.
Silver was also weaker at $4.94/96 versus $4.97/99. The range was seen at $4.99/5.00.
Traders said silver was not as vulnerable on the downside as gold and could jump more than gold if the yellow metal holds at $350 or edges up.
Platinum was down at $354.50/355.50 as against $357.25/358.25.
